fun_facts: Ladd McConkey grew up in Chatsworth, Georgia. As a high-school senior, he piled up 3,051 all-purpose yards while playing quarterback, running back, receiver, and return specialist.
Ladd McConkey also played basketball: his high-school team went 16–0 in its region and finished 20–5 overall during his senior year. He also competed in track and field.
Ladd McConkey helped Georgia win the 2022 national championship. In the title game, he caught five passes for 88 yards and two touchdowns.
Ladd McConkey won the 2023 Wuerffel Trophy, which recognizes a player who combines community service with athletic and academic achievement.
Ladd McConkey set Chargers rookie records with 82 receptions and 1,149 receiving yards.

excerpts:
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Friday, April 26, 2024**

## **Los Angeles Chargers Select McConkey and Colson on Day 2 of NFL Draft**

### The Los Angeles Chargers continued the 2024 NFL Draft with two selections on Friday — Georgia wide receiver **Ladd McConkey** (34th overall) and Michigan linebacker **Junior Colson** (69th overall). The Bolts moved up from No. 37 overall in a trade with the New England Patriots to select McConkey, acquiring the 34th overall choice used to select McConkey and a fifth-round pick (No. 137) in exchange for the 37th overall pick and a fourth- round selection (No. 110). **McConkey** was a key contributor to Georgia’s run to win a College Football Playoff National Championship in 2022, earning second-team All-Southeastern Conference honors and recording career highs in receptions (58), receiving yards (762) and touchdown grabs (seven). In the Bulldogs’ victory in the National Championship game, McConkey hauled in five catches for 88 yards (17.6 avg.)
